hook.rumour: Behind the bulwark of Raven Rock, Redoran guards battle ash-spawn from the southern waste while Skaal hunters report sleep-walking villagers chanting around the Earth Stone.
hook.notice: COUNCILOR MORVAYN'S MANOR, RAVEN ROCK — Aid requested to defend the ash-bulwark, consult Master Neloth at Tel Mithryn, and parley with the Skaal.
hook.context: Solstheim is a single island split between two ages: ash-choked Redoran Raven Rock and Tel Mithryn in the south, and the pine-clad Nord Skaal lands in the north.

stages.objective: Speak with Councilor Morvayn's guard-captain at the southern bulwark of Raven Rock
Clear the ash-spawn patrol advancing past Old Attius Farm
Inspect the entranced stone-workers gathered around the Earth Stone

objectives.text: Speak with Councilor Morvayn's guard-captain at the southern bulwark of Raven Rock
Clear the ash-spawn patrol advancing past Old Attius Farm
Inspect the entranced stone-workers gathered around the Earth Stone

consequence_detail.summary: Heartstones taken from the ash-spawn at Old Attius Farm and the chant at the Earth Stone point to Tel Mithryn and Fort Frostmoth.

stages.objective: Consult Master Neloth inside the giant mushroom tower of Tel Mithryn
Disrupt the Morag Tong renegade cell fortifying Ashfallow Citadel
Shatter the heartstone-resonator hidden in the curtain wall of Fort Frostmoth

objectives.text: Consult Master Neloth inside the giant mushroom tower of Tel Mithryn
Disrupt the Morag Tong renegade cell fortifying Ashfallow Citadel
Shatter the heartstone-resonator hidden in the curtain wall of Fort Frostmoth

consequence_detail.summary: The heartstone-resonator at Fort Frostmoth is shattered, Stemming the ash-spawn raids on Raven Rock's southern wall.

stages.objective: Take counsel with the Skaal elders at Skaal Village on the corrupted All-Maker conduits
Rally the Nord warriors at Thirsk Mead Hall to guard the northern pass
Enter the sunken Dwemer city of Nchardak and release the steam-aqueduct locks

objectives.text: Take counsel with the Skaal elders at Skaal Village on the corrupted All-Maker conduits
Rally the Nord warriors at Thirsk Mead Hall to guard the northern pass
Enter the sunken Dwemer city of Nchardak and release the steam-aqueduct locks

consequence_detail.summary: With Nchardak's steam-locks opened and Thirsk holding the pass, the outer cult sanctuary at the Temple of Miraak is exposed.

stages.objective: Defeat the cult overseers in the outer sanctum of the Temple of Miraak
Bring word of the cleansed sanctum to the Greathall of Skaal Village
Witness Councilor Morvayn and the Skaal envoys seal the Solstheim Island Accord in Raven Rock

objectives.text: Defeat the cult overseers in the outer sanctum of the Temple of Miraak
Bring word of the cleansed sanctum to the Greathall of Skaal Village
Witness Councilor Morvayn and the Skaal envoys seal the Solstheim Island Accord in Raven Rock

rewards.title: Hearth-Friend of Raven Rock and Skaal

consequence_detail.summary: The cult overseers at the Temple of Miraak are broken, the sleep-curse lifts, and Redoran Raven Rock and the Skaal seal a lasting island pact.
